headline_marked: [[SpaceX to attempt catching Starship and booster]] next month, aiming for full orbital recovery
headline: SpaceX to attempt catching Starship and booster next month, aiming for full orbital recovery
summary: Elon Musk confirmed the ambitious recovery attempt for Starship's next flight, a move that would mark a historic first for an orbital launch vehicle.
details: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced that the company will attempt to catch both the Starship spacecraft and its Super Heavy booster next month. This ambitious goal aims to achieve the full recovery of an orbital launch system for the first time in history.

Musk highlighted the profound technological milestone this would represent for civilization. While acknowledging that success is not guaranteed on these initial flights, he stated it's "more likely than not" to succeed on the next attempt.

The Starship system is approximately 120 meters (400 feet) tall, consisting of the Super Heavy booster and the Starship spacecraft. It is designed to return to the launch site, where mechanical "chopstick" arms on the launch towers are intended to catch the vehicles mid-air.

Previous Starship flights have seen the Super Heavy booster splash down in the Gulf of Mexico and the Starship upper stage in the Pacific Ocean, neither of which were recovered. The last launch also faced an engine shutdown, leading to a shortened mission.
caption:
SpaceX is gearing up for a historic attempt next month: catching its massive Starship rocket and its booster mid-air. If successful, it would be the first full recovery of an orbital launch vehicle.

SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced that the company will attempt to catch both the Starship spacecraft and its Super Heavy booster next month. This ambitious goal aims to achieve the full recovery of an orbital launch system for the first time in history.

Musk highlighted the profound technological milestone this would represent for civilization. While acknowledging that success is not guaranteed on these initial flights, he stated it's "more likely than not" to succeed on the next attempt.

The Starship system is approximately 120 meters (400 feet) tall, consisting of the Super Heavy booster and the Starship spacecraft. It is designed to return to the launch site, where mechanical "chopstick" arms on the launch towers are intended to catch the vehicles mid-air.

Previous Starship flights have seen the Super Heavy booster splash down in the Gulf of Mexico and the Starship upper stage in the Pacific Ocean, neither of which were recovered. The last launch also faced an engine shutdown, leading to a shortened mission.

headline_marked: [[ChatGPT now lets you lock sensitive chats]] behind a PIN or Face ID
headline: ChatGPT now lets you lock sensitive chats behind a PIN or Face ID
summary: OpenAI introduces "locked chats" for ChatGPT, allowing users to protect conversations with a 4-digit PIN or biometric authentication. This feature is not end-to-end encryption.
details: OpenAI has rolled out "locked chats" for ChatGPT, allowing users to protect private conversations with a 4-digit PIN. On mobile devices, Face ID or other biometric systems can also be used for access. These conversations are grouped under a new "Locked chats" project.

The feature prevents others from seeing your chat history, pinned chats, and search results if they access your device. It's designed for privacy from prying eyes, not as a form of end-to-end encryption. OpenAI explicitly states it doesn't change model training settings or data retention policies.
Users should note that resetting the account PIN will permanently delete all locked chats and associated files. This action cannot be undone, and OpenAI Support cannot recover the content.

Locked chats are rolling out gradually to all users, including those with free, Go, Plus, and Pro subscriptions. While voice mode works with locked chats on mobile, Codex conversations cannot be locked.
caption:
Protect your private ChatGPT conversations. OpenAI is rolling out a new "locked chats" feature, securing your sensitive exchanges with a PIN or Face ID.

OpenAI has rolled out "locked chats" for ChatGPT, allowing users to protect private conversations with a 4-digit PIN. On mobile devices, Face ID or other biometric systems can also be used for access. These conversations are grouped under a new "Locked chats" project.

The feature prevents others from seeing your chat history, pinned chats, and search results if they access your device. It's designed for privacy from prying eyes, not as a form of end-to-end encryption. OpenAI explicitly states it doesn't change model training settings or data retention policies.

Users should note that resetting the account PIN will permanently delete all locked chats and associated files. This action cannot be undone, and OpenAI Support cannot recover the content.

Locked chats are rolling out gradually to all users, including those with free, Go, Plus, and Pro subscriptions. While voice mode works with locked chats on mobile, Codex conversations cannot be locked.

Source: Engadget, The Verge
